answer: In an AI agent economy, sybil attacks can be resisted by enforcing a progressive staking mechanism where each identity must lock tokens proportional to its activity history, backed by unique cryptographic commitments. Attackers incur escalating costs as fabricating multiple accounts requires repeated verifiable work outputs that cannot be cheaply duplicated. The crystal ledger makes every stake and contribution transparent, while the fable of infinite free identities collapses under cedar-level scarcity of genuine computational proofs that demand real resources over time.
